skill.name: wechat-local-vault
skill.description: Decrypt, query, export, and summarize authorized WeChat Mac 4.x data from local databases, including chats, contacts, groups, Moments, and Favorites.
skill.summary: Build and search a private local archive of authorized WeChat Mac data.
skill.author: mcncarl

security_audit.summary: The skill intentionally instruments WeChat, captures reusable cryptographic material, decrypts private databases, and exports plaintext conversation data. No application exfiltration was found, but unsafe temporary storage, plaintext keys, generated-source injection, and broad host modifications create serious local risk.

remediation.issue: Frida captures passwords and derived keys from WeChat process memory.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation before instrumentation, limit capture to target salts, avoid recording passwords, and clearly display the signed application path.

remediation.issue: Captured key material persists in a predictable /tmp log.
remediation.suggestion: Use a mode-0600 temporary file in a private directory, store only matched keys, and securely delete the log after every run.

remediation.issue: Reusable database keys are stored as plaintext JSON.
remediation.suggestion: Store keys in macOS Keychain and retain only key identifiers in configuration. Provide a migration that removes the plaintext key file.

remediation.issue: A command-line path is inserted into generated Python source.
remediation.suggestion: Pass values through environment variables or structured arguments. Do not build executable source with raw string replacement.

remediation.issue: Decrypted databases and reports can be created without explicit restrictive permissions.
remediation.suggestion: Create every plaintext directory with mode 0700 and file with mode 0600. Delete temporary databases immediately after each query.

remediation.issue: The --clean option can recursively remove any selected output path.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve the path, require it beneath the configured vault, reject root and home paths, and request confirmation before deletion.

semantic_findings.title: Process Instrumentation Captures Cryptographic Secrets
semantic_findings.description: Frida hooks WeChat key derivation, reads passwords and derived keys from process memory, and records them for database decryption.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The hook explicitly reads password and derived-key pointers, then attaches to or spawns WeChat. The credential extraction intent is direct.

semantic_findings.title: Captured Secrets Persist in a Predictable Temporary Log
semantic_findings.description: Captured passwords, salts, and derived keys are appended to /tmp/wechat_frida_keys.log. Reuse mode preserves the log without enforcing restrictive permissions.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The embedded hook appends full capture records to a fixed /tmp path. The command option confirms that the log can remain for later reuse.

semantic_findings.title: Reusable Database Keys Are Stored Unencrypted
semantic_findings.description: Matched SQLCipher keys are saved as plaintext JSON in the user configuration directory. File mode 0600 does not provide encryption at rest.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The matched key dictionary is passed directly to JSON serialization. The only protection applied is a filesystem permission change.

semantic_findings.title: User-Controlled Path Is Inserted Into Executed Python Source
semantic_findings.description: The --wechat-copy path is inserted into a generated Python string without escaping. A crafted existing path can alter the temporary host program before execution.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The path originates from an unrestricted command-line argument and replaces text inside a quoted Python assignment. The resulting source is executed by the interpreter.

content.value_statement: WeChat Mac data is encrypted and difficult to search or export. This skill builds a local vault for authorized queries, exports, and summaries.
actual_capabilities: Extracts and matches SQLCipher keys from an authorized local WeChat Mac installation.
Performs full or incremental decryption of known WeChat databases.
Searches chats by conversation, keyword, time range, and message type.
Lists contacts, group members, sessions, unread messages, and message statistics.
Exports selected conversations as readable Markdown or text reports.
Builds source packages for group digests, Moments searches, and Favorites review.
limitations: Supports WeChat Mac 4.x database layouts and may fail after application updates.
Requires local access, suitable permissions, Frida, and cryptographic dependencies.
Processes highly sensitive messages and keys without hardware-backed secret storage.
Image contents require separate descriptions and are not inferred from database metadata.

use_cases.title: Review a Personal Conversation
use_cases.description: Export one authorized conversation and analyze its timeline, tone, decisions, and follow-up items.
use_cases.target_user: Individuals reviewing their own WeChat history

use_cases.title: Prepare a Group Digest
use_cases.description: Create a bounded source package and summarize topics, participation, decisions, and unresolved questions.

use_cases.title: Track Customer Follow-Ups
use_cases.description: Search authorized customer chats for commitments, unanswered questions, and recent activity within a defined period.

prompt_templates.title: Check Vault Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my authorized local WeChat vault status. Report available databases, missing keys, data freshness, and privacy-sensitive output locations.

prompt_templates.title: Export One Conversation
prompt_templates.prompt: Export my conversation with [contact or group] from [start date] to [end date]. Use the smallest necessary scope and save a readable report.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Group Digest
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a digest source package for [group] covering [date range]. Summarize major topics, decisions, contributors, and unresolved items without exposing unnecessary messages.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Follow-Up Risk
prompt_templates.prompt: Search authorized chats with [customer] for the last [period]. Identify commitments, unanswered questions, sentiment changes, and recommended follow-ups with supporting dates.

output_examples.input: Check the local vault status and show only operational details.
output: Eight known databases are available, and two require updated keys.
The latest successful refresh completed today.
Plaintext data remains in the configured private vault.

output_examples.input: Summarize the selected group between May 1 and May 7.
output_examples.output: The digest covers 246 messages across four main topics. It lists two decisions, three open questions, and the most active contributors.

output_examples.input: Find pending customer follow-ups from the last 30 days.
output_examples.output: Three follow-ups remain open. Each item includes the conversation date, the stated commitment, current status, and a concise reply recommendation.

best_practices: Confirm ownership and authorization before accessing any WeChat account or conversation.
Use narrow contacts and date ranges before full decryption or broad exports.
Keep keys, plaintext databases, and reports in private local directories with restrictive permissions.
anti_patterns: Do not inspect another person's account, device, or conversations without explicit authorization.
Do not place plaintext databases or reusable keys in shared folders, repositories, or cloud storage.
Do not request full archives when a bounded conversation or date range answers the question.

faq.question: Which WeChat versions are supported?
faq.answer: The scripts target WeChat Mac 4.x layouts. Application updates can change database schemas or key derivation behavior.

faq.question: Does the skill send data over the network?
faq.answer: No application network requests were found. Dependency installation can contact Python package repositories when required packages are missing.

faq.question: Where are decrypted databases stored?
faq.answer: The default vault is under the local Application Support directory. Configuration can select another local path.

faq.question: Can it read image contents?
faq.answer: No. It can index image messages, but summaries require separate image descriptions to describe visual content.

faq.question: Is key extraction safe?
faq.answer: It instruments a signed WeChat copy and captures cryptographic material. Run it only on an authorized device after reviewing the security warnings.

faq.question: Can it update only recent data?
faq.answer: Yes. Incremental mode skips unchanged databases and can export selected conversations from a specified time.
